title: GNSS receivers and NMEA 0183: from satellites to a trusted fix
summary: Write NAVERA Lite's GNSS part: a robust NMEA 0183 reader (checksum, GGA, GSA), dilution of precision from the satellite geometry, and the decision FIX / DEGRADED / NO_FIX with σ from HDOP. You forge a line that fools the checksum and run a damaged 19 km drive through your judge.
